concerns.text: The plan creates a deterministic gold‑standard intent annotation set of 50 samples via rule‑based extraction (ensuring a reproducible κ ≥ 0.6). FR‑008 requires a *human‑annotated* gold‑standard with inter‑annotator agreement ≥ 0.6; a rule‑based dataset does not satisfy this requirement and may invalidate the intent‑entity evaluation.
